title: &str lifetime when variable is borrowed as argument (not captured) by closure
author: venezuela-wq57
body_preview: ``` fn myfn(str: &str) {  let c = |s: &mut Option<&str>| *s = Some(str); } ``` Compiler says ``` let c = |s: &mut Option<&str>| *s = Some(str);   |                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ assignment requires that `'1` must outlive `'static` ``` If I change the code to ``` fn myfn(str: &str) {  let mut var = None;  let c = || var = Some(str); } ``` It compiles.
